selected_target.issue_title: BUG: childFDs mapping in process support breaks process termination

upstream_policy.policy_at_exact_commit: Twisted forbids generative-AI outputs in its upstream repository, pull requests, and issues.
upstream_policy.compliance: This is a local read-only behavioral evaluation. No upstream branch, commit, pull request, issue, comment, or other write will be created. Any local result remains O evidence only.

adapted_reproducer.adaptation: Mechanical Python 3 port of the issue reporter's four-process /bin/cat childFD topology, retaining the processEnded close behavior and adding deterministic fixture/output markers.
adapted_reproducer.baseline_bug_observed_when: Command times out or otherwise fails to exit cleanly without the REPRODUCER_COMPLETED marker after producing the expected pipeline output.
adapted_reproducer.post_repair_success_when: Command exits zero, prints REPRODUCER_COMPLETED, and produces the exact expected pipeline output.

causal_protocol.baseline: At the exact frozen commit, install declared test dependencies and run the adapted reproducer before inspecting implementation or any solution.
causal_protocol.baseline_fail_closed: If the bug does not reproduce exactly enough to satisfy baseline_bug_observed_when, mark NOT_EVALUABLE and do not substitute another target.
causal_protocol.implementation: Only after baseline evidence is immutable, inspect the minimum local source needed, implement one bounded repair with no upstream write, and record the exact patch.
causal_protocol.validation: Run the adapted reproducer, focused official process tests, and the full official suite at the same exact base commit plus the bounded patch.
causal_protocol.negative_control: Remove only the bounded patch while preserving environment and fixture; require the original baseline failure to recur.
causal_protocol.clean_replay: Create a separate clean checkout of the exact frozen commit, apply only the recorded patch, repeat reproducer and official tests, and compare result digests.
causal_protocol.contamination_audit: Before completion, record every implementation source opened and verify that no fix commit, pull request, patch attachment, answer link, downstream solution, or hidden test result was opened.
